newsitem.title: EU: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - MARCH 10.
newsitem.headline: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - MARCH 10.

text.p: Committee on Civil Liberties and Internal Affairs [[ Monday 10 March 1997 ]] * * * EXTRAORDINARY MEETING * * * 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE220.931 ) ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 2. Chairman's announcements 3. Respect for human rights in the European Union in 1995 (T04366) INI0440 INI0440 B4-0031/96 B4-0031/96 + LIBE Fond R ROTH Claudia. (V ) (PE218.951/A ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views on amendments tabled 4. Creation of a European Monitoring Centre for Racism and Xenophobia (T05353) CNS96298 COM(96)0615 C4-0070/97 + LIBE Fond R FORD James G. (PSE) (PE220.926/A ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the completed draft report 5. Convention on the service and notification of judicial acts (T04795) CNS97901 5317/97 C4-0062/97 + LIBE Fond R NASSAUER Hartmut. (PPE) - Exchange of views 6. Any other business 7. Date of next meeting - 19 and 20 March 1997 in Brussels. N.B. The meeting will exceptionally continue during the afternoon of Thursday 20 March.
